title: Systemic & regional surgery
objectives: Work up antenatal hydronephrosis, VUR and PUV from scan to decision.
Grade hypospadias and state when to operate and when to stage.
Outline neurogenic bladder management from CIC to augmentation.
body_md:
### Why this area matters

The largest module by question count — urology alone could fill a paper. Add thoracic (CPAM, empyema, pectus), head-neck (clefts, branchial, thyroglossal), neurosurgery (NTDs, hydrocephalus) and DSD. Breadth beats depth here; know every entity's workup spine.

### Urology spines

Antenatal hydronephrosis: postnatal US timing, MCU, then diuretic renography; UPJ obstruction with declining function or symptoms gets pyeloplasty. VUR: grade on MCU, prophylaxis versus reimplantation by grade, breakthrough infections and scarring as escalation triggers. PUV: antenatal oligohydramnios and keyhole bladder, postnatal catheter drainage, valve ablation, then lifelong valve-bladder surveillance — nadir creatinine predicts the renal future. Hypospadias: meatal position plus chordee grade the repair; distal single-stage, severe proximal staged; operate in the 6–18 month window. Undescended testis: examine, image only the impalpable, laparoscopy as diagnostic and therapeutic, orchidopexy before one year where possible.

### Neurogenic bladder and DSD

Clean intermittent catheterisation plus anticholinergics is the base; augmentation (ileocystoplasty) and continent channels (Mitrofanoff/Monti) serve low-compliance, high-pressure, incontinent bladders threatening kidneys. DSD: karyotype, hormones, imaging and psychology before assignment; CAH salt-wasting is the emergency within the workup.

### Thoracic, head-neck, neuro

CPAM: CVR above ~1.6 flags hydrops risk; steroids for microcystic high-risk lesions, drainage for dominant macrocysts, resection for symptomatic postnatal disease. Empyema stages decide fibrinolytics versus VATS/decortication. Branchial and thyroglossal lesions excise completely (Sistrunk includes hyoid core). NTDs: folate prevention, MOMS-trial fetal repair criteria, tethered-cord surveillance; hydrocephalus shunts need the complication list (obstruction, infection, overdrainage) on demand.

### How it is asked

Workup spines with decision thresholds, operative indications with timing, and lifelong follow-up plans. Urology answers that stop at surgery lose the follow-up marks.
